_comment: Swolverine product-photo house spec. Values decoded from Chance's creatine front edit (WIP/Product-Images.psd) and approved on 2026-09-24/25. Change only with Chance's sign-off.

reflection._comment: Flipped product silhouette in black at 10/255 opacity. The flip axis puts the silhouette's top 97px above the product bottom, hidden behind the product: refl(y) = alpha(2*baseline - overlap - y).

_podium_comment: Median 8-bit RGB of the podium's side band in the creatine shoot (CreatineMonohydrate-1 1.tif, rows 3450-3600, cols 3800-4200). Every new shoot is gain-matched to this before the tone LUT.

sessions._comment: Exposure is matched per capture session (EXIF DateTimeOriginal date). Within a session the camera and podium don't move, so other raws are matched to the session's reference raw by comparing the podium at identical pixel coordinates. Add a new session only after Chance approves its look.

2026-08-31.note: Creatine shoot. Chance's hand edit defines the house look; no gain. WheyIsolate-Vanilla-Front was also shot this day but zoomed in with the bag on the riser, so same-pixel podium matching is invalid (the wall check catches it); gain 1, approved 2026-09-25.
2026-08-31.reference_raw_note: Chance deleted the raw from Raw/ (2026-09-30); a copy is Archive/CreatineMonohydrate-1 1 (1).tif, which find_ref_raw() uses.

2026-09-04.note: Whey shoot, approved 2026-09-25. About 5 levels brighter and warmer than the creatine shoot. PreBundle.tif is from this session but shot at ISO 400 (others ISO 320). Chance preferred the vanilla's lighting: the chocolate Front/Back were light-matched to WheyIsolate-Vanilla:Front (match-light, 2026-09-25).
2026-09-04.reference_raw_note: WheyIsolate-Front.tif was deleted (2026-09-30), so same-session ratios can't be measured. The tabletop riser setup (Beta-Alanine, L-Glutamine) was brighter: approved with --gain 0.9323,0.9390,0.9418 (white-anchored to CitrullineMalate:Front) on 2026-10-01.
